name: DeepSeek
description: DeepSeek is an AI company operated by Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. Their mission is to develop open-weight large language models that enable reasoning, tool-use and private deployment, offering an alternative path in the large-model ecosystem.

sources.notes: DeepSeek's official terms identify Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. as the owner/operator of its products and services.
DeepSeek's official privacy policy identifies the same Hangzhou entity and refers to its registered address in China.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified through the legal operating entity; the source does not establish an exclusive headquarters claim.
